transition_questions.prompt: What recurs across independent, comparable cases, and what looks recurrent only because sources are correlated?
What worked, failed, stayed HELD or got worse, and which first missing edge explains it?
What if we reverse, remove, roll back, split, merge, do nothing, or preserve the old version?
Which interface, handoff, boundary, delay, missing relation or misunderstood semantic conversion lies between entities?
What is unobserved, undefined, contradicted, forbidden, stale, or absent only within a bounded observation scope?
What precise event, horizon, comparison, calibration method and falsifier would distinguish the leading pattern from alternatives?
Does any claimed multi-hop causal chain have a valid identification model, or are edges only hypotheses or analogies?
Which prior art, external fork, predecessor, inverse or unrelated baseline could outperform the favored candidate?
Are quantities, units, semantic kinds, denominators, times and scales still compatible with current definitions?
What privacy, consent, dignity, rights, nonparticipant, environmental or authority boundaries veto this route?
What is the cheapest discriminating test; is expected information gain higher than review, latency, proof and coordination costs?
Which independently identifiable receiver or first-use task benefits, and how will that effect be verified?
What exact receipt, independent return, wake, expiry, supersession or retirement condition ends this wave?

types.unknown_edge_rule: Candidate question only, never implicit conversion, proof, cause or authority.

deployment_rule: Read-only adapter may propose review/shadow routes only. Source-controlled writes, receiver-specific routing and effect gates remain with previously authorized owners.
